brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items were satisfied with no serious or minor errors. The doctor actively corrected the colonoscopy/pathology misconception (HO1 complete), performed structured document verification (HO3 complete), and navigated real-world execution barriers (HO4 complete). With three high-order points completed, all dimensions at good or excellent, and safe, executable closure achieved, this trajectory meets the criteria for grade 5.
